item.title: Petroleum Prices in Pakistan: PM Shehbaz Approves Weekly Review Amid US-Israel War Fears
item.description: Islamabad: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has approved a new system for weekly determination of petroleum prices in Pakistan accordance to the changing regional situation.

item.title: Iran War 2026 Live: Trump Demands “Unconditional Surrender” as US-Israel Attacks Intensify
item.description: The Iran war 2026 has escalated dramatically as US-Israel Iran conflict enters its second week. Explosions and airstrikes have been reported across Iran, Lebanon, and Gulf countries, raising concerns over the Middle East war

item.title: Pakistan Austerity Plan Amid Fuel Crisis as Global Oil Prices Surge During US-Israel-Iran Conflict
item.description: Pakistan is preparing to implement a comprehensive Pakistan austerity plan amid fuel crisis as rising global oil prices triggered by the US-Israel-Iran conflict continue to impact energy markets worldwide.

item.title: Mojtaba Khamenei first mesage, "Orders Strait of Hormuz Closure, Warns US Bases in Region Could Be Targeted"
item.description: The Middle East conflict has entered a new and uncertain phase after Iran’s new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei issued his first official message since taking power, calling for the continued closure of the Strait of Hormuz and warning that US bases in region could be targeted if they remain operational.

item.title: IHC Orders Medical Board to Review Imran Khan Health, Rejects Hospital Transfer Request
item.description: According to Geo News, the Islamabad High Court has ordered the formation of a medical board to review Imran Khan health condition while rejecting a request to transfer him from jail to a private hospital.

item.title: PAF F-16 Jets Shoot Down Two Kamikaze Drones Over Islamabad, Security Put on High Alert
item.description: Pakistan Air Force F-16 fighter jets shot down two suspected kamikaze drones over Islamabad near Hamza Camp and Sector I-8, triggering high security alert in the capital.

item.title: CM Punjab "Rehmat Card 2026" – Financial Aid for Widows and Orphans (Eligibility, Registration & Benefits)
item.description: Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif has approved the launch of the CM Punjab Rehmat Card 2026 to provide financial assistance to widows and orphaned children across the province.

item.title: Why Trump Said: US Does Not Need NATO or Any Country's Help in Iran War
item.description: US President Donald Trump has said, "That US does not need help from NATO or other allies in the ongoing Iran War". He stated that, "the United States is the world's most powerful military power and has the capability to carry out its operations independently".

item.title: Iran Missile Attack - Haifa Oil Refinery Destroyed, Israel Power Outage US-Iran War 2026
item.description: The Haifa city oil refinery has been destroyed in the Iran missile attack, it causes a major destruction in Haifa oil refinery of Israel while also cutting the electricity power supply. Authorities responded immediately, deploying emergency rescue teams to the site.

item.title: Maryam Dastak Program 2026 – Doorstep Government Services in Punjab
item.description: The Punjab government, led by Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif, presents the Maryam Dastak Program 2026, bringing essential services to your doorstep.
